blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Artificial intelligence (AI) could change how Filipinos work, manage their money, and access everyday services. But will these changes improve people’s lives, or create new challenges? These questions took center stage during the second and final day of the Asean Business and Investment Summit (ABIS) 2026 on Sunday, November 15, as business leaders, policymakers, and technology experts discussed the opportunities and risks of digital transformation across Southeast Asia. Across the panel discussions and keynote addresses, one message emerged: technological progress must be matched by workforce development, consumer protection, and investments that deliver meaningful benefits.
